verifyEmail.subject: Verify your email
verifyEmail.heading: Verify your email
verifyEmail.intro: Confirm this email address to finish setting up your account.
verifyEmail.expiry: This verification link expires in {minutes} minutes.
verifyEmail.safety: If this was not you, you can ignore this email.

changeEmail.subject: Confirm email change
changeEmail.heading: Confirm your email change
changeEmail.intro: We received a request to change your account email to {email}.
changeEmail.expiry: This confirmation link expires in {minutes} minutes.
changeEmail.safety: If this was not you, secure your account.

resetPassword.subject: Reset your password
resetPassword.heading: Reset your password
resetPassword.intro: We received a request to reset your account password.
resetPassword.expiry: This reset link expires in {minutes} minutes.
resetPassword.safety: If this was not you, you can ignore this email.

verifyEmail.subject: 验证你的邮箱
verifyEmail.heading: 验证你的邮箱
verifyEmail.intro: 请确认这个邮箱地址，以完成账号设置。
verifyEmail.expiry: 此验证链接将在 {minutes} 分钟后过期。
verifyEmail.safety: 如果这不是你本人操作，可以忽略这封邮件。

changeEmail.subject: 确认邮箱变更
changeEmail.heading: 确认你的邮箱变更
changeEmail.intro: 我们收到请求，要将你的账号邮箱改为 {email}。
changeEmail.expiry: 此确认链接将在 {minutes} 分钟后过期。
changeEmail.safety: 如果这不是你本人操作，请检查账号安全。

resetPassword.subject: 重置你的密码
resetPassword.heading: 重置你的密码
resetPassword.intro: 我们收到了一次重置账号密码的请求。
resetPassword.expiry: 此重置链接将在 {minutes} 分钟后过期。
resetPassword.safety: 如果这不是你本人操作，可以忽略这封邮件。
